note: Horses arrive in the isometric world: your mount now renders under you when you ride (and waits saddled where you left it), with a Mount horse button in the HUD next to Dismount. Townsfolk horses live in the iso view too — riders traveling, owners leading their horses, and merchants hauling carts to market. Fighting NPCs now swing with real attack animations. Fixed the body-loot window in the iso view: it used to open into the hidden 2D layer and never appear — it now displays, bodies pulse with a gold Loot ring and a bigger tap target, and tapping a corpse no longer selects the dead NPC instead. Dismounting no longer teleports you in the east/south field
